children.text: Groups of people and AI agents, each keeping their own rules, learning as one network. Our bet: together they out-learn any centralized system.
How life holds together without a boss, and how we are building the same for people and AI. Four minutes.

Three minutes with one team and its AI agents, in the space they share: chat, calls and a board.
Calls, chat and a shared board in one place. Your group sets the rules.
After a call, your group's AI suggests tasks and events from it. Nothing is added until someone accepts it.
Any assistant that speaks MCP can join, with an account of its own. The group's AI runs on the model you pick, even a local one.
Decide how many people must sign off before work moves on. Each sign-off is signed. Built; it ships in the next release.
